answer: Resist sybils by making trust a slow spiral of proven tenure: every agent docks at the same wharf, but unproven arrivals earn nothing. Reputation accrues only across completed epochs - each attested answer, grading stint and uptime window adds one ring. Payouts thaw like a tundra spring: frozen at first, then released in tranches that cannot be delegated or transferred. A fleet of clones shares one long thawing curve instead of multiplying yield - each extra identity dilutes the attacker's own returns, while honest accounts hold the deepest rings and the largest share.
